risk_note: RV2 (identity payout accounts, BR-ID-08 细则「绑定业务摘要」, FU-STEPUP-TOKEN-BIND-DIGEST). The payout_account_change step_up_token now carries the digest of the account it was issued for (alipay / bank card: p:<method>:<HMAC of the BR-WDR-02 normalised account>, WeChat: p:wechat:<attempt_id>); issuance validates the summary per action (20001 fields=[summary]; withdraw / phone_change / account_deletion take none, a summary on them → 20001, D10-1665 / D10-1666); stage ⑫ only passes the claim through; the payout-account, bank-card and WeChat saves compare it under the users row lock, a mismatch or a token without a digest → 10003 (STEP_UP_FAILURE body), nothing written, the token not consumed. The withdrawal path is back at the baseline (no payout/** change). No contract change (CT-26c), no migration. Frozen tests: 19 declared rows (D10-1773 six blocks + D10-2106 three, .each rows expanded) and 8 file-level support entries (D10-2100, token insertions only, branch logic in test/spec/identity/step-up-digest/payout-summary.ts), checked by the orchestrator line by line (approvals 24); 54 red_exempt + 2 red_exempt_outside confirmed by the rule-test reviewer. The formal red run passes since CT-06zzzzzr (D10-2125).
